annotations.title: Estimate the basis step-up on inherited stocks and funds

description: For U.S.-listed stocks, ETFs, mutual funds or crypto held at someone's death (directly, in an estate or in a revocable living trust), estimates the value on the date of death from public market prices, the IRC §1014 step-up in cost basis and the capital-gains tax the heirs avoid (15%–23.8%), plus the dates that matter: the §2032 alternate valuation date, the Form 706 due date and the last day for a portability election (Rev. Proc. 2022-32). Valuation follows Treas. Reg. §20.2031-2(b) (mean of high and low, weekend and no-trade days weighted) and §20.2031-8(b) for funds. Up to 25 holdings. An estimate for planning, not a signed valuation a broker or the IRS will accept; the reply says where to get one.

date_of_death.description: Date of death, YYYY-MM-DD (must be before today).

holdings.description: Holdings at the date of death.

asset_type.description: Optional; detected from the symbol. Give crypto for BTC, ETH and other coins.

original_cost.description: Total original cost basis of this holding, USD. Optional; needed to compute the step-up.

shares.description: Shares or units held at death.

symbol.description: Ticker as listed in the U.S., e.g. AAPL, BRK.B, VFIAX, BTC.

name: estimate_inheritance_step_up
title: Estimate the basis step-up on inherited stocks and funds
